original_source_text: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as the state-of-the-art (SOTA) technique for novel view synthesis. This paper introduces an algorithm that employs a two-stage pipeline. First, a 2D Gaussian (2DGS) model is rendered via the nearest Gaussian's color. Subsequently, this depth map is utilized for the second stage: a sort-free, weighted rendering of the complete 3DGS model. We further propose CODA, a unified hardware accelerator co-optimized to execute this 2D-3D hybrid pipeline. Experimental results demonstrate that CODA exhibits an 8.4× to 11.6× speedup over the NVIDIA RTX 3060M and a 2.7× to 3.9× speedup over the NVIDIA RTX 4090.
